I’m happy to help interpret those numbers!  
The pair **37.4224764, –122.0842499** points to the Googleplex campus in Mountain View, California (the headquarters of Google).  

If you’d like to confirm this with the Google Geocoding API, you would make a request such as:

```
https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?latlng=37.4224764,-122.0842499&key=YOUR_API_KEY
```

That call will return a JSON payload containing the formatted address (“1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA …”) along with other metadata.  

Because I don’t have an actual API key here, I can’t execute the request myself, but the coordinates you supplied are indeed the standard latitude/longitude for the Googleplex.
